elementName: Delivery or transport terms function code

values.name: Price condition
values.description: Specifies a condition related to the price which a seller must fulfil before the buyer will complete a purchase.

values.name: Despatch condition
values.description: Condition requested by the customer under which the supplier shall deliver: Extent of freight costs, means of transport.

values.name: Price and despatch condition
values.description: Condition related to price and despatch that the seller must complete before the customer will agree payment.

values.name: Collected by customer
values.description: Indicates that the customer will pick up the goods at the supplier. He will take care of the means of transport.

values.name: Transport condition
values.description: Specifies the conditions under which the transport takes place under the responsibility of the carrier.

values.name: Delivery condition
values.description: Specifies the conditions under which the goods must be delivered to the consignee.
